## Current Role

Full-Stack Developer at [Callon Group](https://callon.group) (Sept 2025 – present). Built an LLM-backed contract review pipeline that extracts and risk-scores clauses from PDFs (Python, Pydantic, Streamlit); a Next.js + SQLite tool indexing 1,000+ contract line items for bill-of-quantities pricing; migrated Callon Group's WordPress site off legacy infra (9s → 300ms page loads), then rebuilt it in Astro on Cloudflare Pages (~3s → ~50ms international TTFB). The rebuilt site became a direct revenue channel — Callon Group won new clients through it, with inbound leads attributed to ChatGPT and AI search recommendations.

- ProTakeoff fork (Jul 2026): real-time multi-user PDF measurement for construction/quantity surveyors (Yjs CRDT, Cloudflare Pages + Functions + D1 + R2).

- Custom Keyboards (Nov 2024 – now): webcam hand scanner (MediaPipe) generating parametric keyboard layouts; two nRF52840 PCBs designed in KiCad; merged PRs to ZMK Studio.
